title: Central, Gqeberha (Russell Rd, approx.): man, 52, shot dead in his car, 19 Oct
summary: Police say a man of 52 was shot by two male suspects while sitting in his car, a white VW Polo, outside a corner shop in Russell Road, Central, Gqeberha, at about 12:50 on Monday 19 October. He tried to get out, collapse...
story: Police say a man of 52 was shot by two male suspects while sitting in his car, a white VW Polo, outside a corner shop in Russell Road, Central, Gqeberha, at about 12:50 on Monday 19 October. He tried to get out, collapsed behind the car and died at the scene; the suspects fled in another white VW Polo (police spokesperson Brigadier Nobuntu Gantana, via The Herald). Humewood police opened a murder case. Algoa FM, in its own reporting after citing police, says the motive is unknown at this stage. No arrest has been reported. The victim is not named here. Three reports, all resting on police: The Herald, Algoa FM and PE Express (PE Express gives his age as 50).
incident: Mon 19 Oct 2026, at about 12:50 (police, via The Herald and PE Express; Algoa FM: shortly before 1 pm)
reported: 20 Oct 2026 (Algoa FM 08:12, PE Express 12:17, The Herald 16:59 SAST)
location_note: Outside a corner shop in Russell Road, Central, Gqeberha (police, via The Herald). Exact shop not named. The pin is a point on Russell Road in Central (OpenStreetMap way 30696735), the owner's choice of two Russell Road points about 48 m apart; no source gives anything finer than the road.

provenance.statement_from: SAPS Eastern Cape, quoted by The Herald, Algoa FM and PE Express
provenance.note: Three reports, all resting on police. The Herald and PE Express carry the same Gantana statement; Algoa FM carries Beetge's account of an initial report, and its motive line is its own narration. Repetition is not independent corroboration.

facts.label: Deaths
facts.detail: Police give his age as 52 (Gantana, via The Herald). Algoa FM also reports 52, in its own words rather than as a police figure. PE Express gives 50; its body paraphrases the same Gantana statement, so the 50 is most likely its own error. Declared dead at the scene. All three reports relay police.
